automation.description: Signs in as admin in SmartClient (desktop UX/UI) and truncates all the data except the bootstrap user, as the last member before the restore, but only once a backup to restore exists.

interaction.name: Check that the backup to restore exists
interaction.description: Opens Data Maintenance and checks a backup is listed, so that the restore has something to bring back.

method.comment: Truncate only when 99-restore.xml has its backup to restore: 00-backup.xml's, the newest

interaction.name: Truncate all the data, keeping the bootstrap user
interaction.description: Presses Truncate on the Data tab, which deletes every row of the customer's data.

method.comment: Truncate deletes every row of the customer's data; 99-restore.xml puts it back

interaction.name: Check the truncate
interaction.description: Signs in again, because the truncate ends the session, and checks that the Data Groups list is empty, which includes the marker left earlier.

method.comment: Truncating re-creates the bootstrap user, which ends this session: sign in again
The marker left after the backup has gone with everything else
